theme_bg.description: Hex color code for the presentation background.

theme_fg.description: Hex color code for the presentation foreground text.

theme_font.description: Name of the system font family to use for slides.

theme_font_size.description: Font size in points for the slide text.

transition_duration.description: Duration of each transition in seconds.

input_file.description: Default plain text file containing slide content.

show_slide_numbers.description: Display slide numbers on the presentation.

aspect_ratio.description: Display aspect ratio code (4 for 4:3, 16 for 16:9).

image_dir.description: Directory to search for images referenced in the presentation.

remote_port.description: TCP port for remote control functionality.

enable_remote.description: Enable remote control via TCP connection.

custom_fonts_list.description: List of custom font file paths to load.

supported_image_extensions.description: List of image file extensions supported by the @ directive.
